title: The metais JSON envelope, version 1
description: The shared members of every document metais prints with --json (ADR-008 D10). Every member is always present, and the members are written in this order: format, ok, findings, summary, result, next. summary, immediately after findings, carries ADR-006 D10 item 4's exact totals, which every envelope carries beside findings; ADR-008 D10 item 1's member list omits it, and this schema reconciles the two. A document is compact UTF-8 on one line ending in one LF. Within major version 1 a format only gains members and enumeration values, and this schema gains them with it.

format.description: The document's format: metais.<command>/1, or metais.usage/1 for a line that names no command.

ok.description: True when the command completed and no finding is of error severity.

findings.description: The findings, in ADR-006 D8's order; usage errors are findings too.

summary.description: The report's exact totals (ADR-006 D10 item 3).

result.description: The command's result, or null when the command was refused before producing one. Each format's schema states its shape.

next.description: The commands to run next (ADR-008 D14); never empty when ok is false.

run.description: A complete metais command line; a value the tool cannot know or must not echo is a placeholder in angle brackets.

why.description: One sentence saying what running it does.
